summary: Insullet filed an 8-K reporting a Ninth Amendment to its May 4, 2021 Credit Agreement, dated September 21, 2026, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent. The $475 million outstanding term loans were refinanced into new term loans at par with margins cut 0.25% to 0.75% base rate / 1.75% SOFR, and revolver commitments rose $250 million to $750 million, undrawn, with margins reduced to 1.25%–1.75%. This is a routine credit-facility repricing and upsize, not a special situation; no equity or deal terms, and Wachtell Lipton advised.
